alt: A page of plain intake notes, an arrow, and a structured profile grid with one highlighted cell labelled Not stated.
caption: The gaps are the useful part: each one is a question your intake meeting missed.

alt: Six circles joined in a line — profiles, contacted, replied, interviewed, offer and hire — with hire highlighted at the end.
caption: Every stage loses people. Work backwards from one hire to see how many you need to find.

alt: A box of target companies shown as dots, an arrow, and a pool-size box with one filled and one faded marker, labelled pool size and competition.
caption: Where these people work, how many exist, and who else is trying to hire them.

alt: Five circles on a timeline labelled day 0, day 3, day 8, day 15 and day 25, with the last one highlighted.
caption: Five messages over about a month. The last one is worth the most over time.

alt: A card labelled Rejected, an arrow, and a card showing an open doorway labelled Door open.
caption: A quick, honest no keeps the door open. Silence closes it.

alt: Three identical interview question cards in a row, labelled structured and unstructured.
caption: Same questions, same scoring, for every candidate.

alt: A job page surrounded by its structured data fields: title, description, datePosted, hiringOrganization, jobLocation and validThrough.
caption: The hidden fields job search reads. Five are required; validThrough is recommended, and stops old listings hanging around.

alt: Five streams of different widths flowing into one basin labelled hires, with cost per hire noted beneath.
caption: The widest stream is not always the one that produces hires.
